text_block_list.text:
A crushing defeat in the exhibition race. 
Symboli Rudolf mocked herself as unfit to 
be "Emperor," tears of bitter regret 
flowing down her face.

However, the Trainer gently affirmed 
Symboli Rudolf— both who she was now and 
who she had always been. As if to prove 
those words—

—Countless Umamusume were gathered there. 
Those whom she had supported until now had 
come together to support her in return.

Having remembered what it means to be the 
"Emperor," she once again harbored a 
resolute will in her eyes.
